contentBlocks.content: Three outputs, three different reasons to watch
Full match recording
The source video. It preserves the available context but takes the longest to review.
Match Highlights
The important supported moments Pitchside identifies for the game. Match Stats & Highlights are included on the Free plan within the monthly recording allowance.
Personal Clips
Moments organised around an individual player where event detection and player identification are supported. Personal Clips are a Paid launch feature.
This distinction must stay consistent across the website and inside the app. “Highlights” should never be used as a vague label that hides which plan includes the output.
What can become a highlight?

The private beta is testing supported events around goals, assists, saves, passes and tackles. A supported event may create a useful review point or clip when the footage and identification are clear enough.
Not every important football moment is easy for a model to see. A defender's positioning, an off-ball run or a pass that changes the shape of the game may matter without becoming a launch highlight.
For the latest event list, use Product Status.
The clip begins with the camera angle
A clear moment needs a clear recording.

items: Mount the phone securely in landscape orientation.
Position it near halfway and above head height.
Keep the goal areas and main playing space visible.
Use two phones when one angle makes the far end too small or loses goal-area detail.
Check lighting, battery, storage and lens cleanliness before kick-off.

contentBlocks.content: See the full guide to record football matches or compare capture options on the football camera app page.
What happens after full-time
Upload the recording through the available Pitchside workflow. The system processes the footage, looks for supported events and returns the available output for review.
This is not instant. Upload and processing can currently take up to 45 minutes during private beta. Video length, connection speed and the developing workflow can affect the result.
Once the output is ready, review the event and player assignment before using or sharing the clip.
A highlight is evidence, not a perfect verdict
Pitchside may miss a moment or identify it incorrectly.
The ball may be hidden. Two players may wear similar kits. A spectator may walk through the frame. The action may happen at the edge of the view.
The page should show these limits beside the best examples. A real difficult clip builds more trust than a gallery that implies every upload works perfectly.
Read more about the underlying capability on AI football analysis.
Share only when you have the right to
Before posting a clip, check the venue, league, team and participant rules that apply to the recording. Extra care may be required when children or vulnerable players are involved.
Pitchside can help organise footage. It does not give a player permission to publish someone else's image.
Read the recording consent and privacy guidance.
Match Highlights are Free. Personal Clips are Paid.

tldrPoints: The full match recording is the source; Match Highlights and Personal Clips are separate outputs.
Free includes Match Stats & Highlights, while Personal Clips are a Paid feature.
The beta is testing goals, assists, saves, passes and tackles as supported moments.
Camera angle, lighting, visibility and player identification affect which clips can be created.
Processing is not instant, and players must have the right to share recorded footage.

faqs.answer: That is the current product focus. The footage needs to give the system a stable and clear enough view of the supported event and players.
faqs.question: Can Pitchside create highlights from phone footage?

faqs.answer: Match Stats & Highlights are included on the Free plan within its one-recording-per-month allowance.
faqs.question: Are football highlights included on the Free plan?

faqs.answer: Personal Clips are Paid output organised around an individual player's supported moments. They depend on both the event and player being identified accurately enough for review.
faqs.question: What are Personal Clips?

faqs.answer: No instant-processing promise should be made. Upload and processing can currently take up to 45 minutes, and the output should be reviewed before it is shared.
faqs.question: Can I post a clip immediately?
Will Pitchside make a clip for every goal?
faqs.answer: Do not guarantee every event. Camera position, visibility and beta capability can affect whether a goal or other moment is identified correctly.

data.metaDescription: Turn suitable phone-recorded small-sided matches into reviewable highlights and player moments. Compare Free Match Highlights with Paid Personal Clips.
data.aeoQuickAnswer: AI football highlights use match footage to identify supported moments and organise them into shorter clips for review. Pitchside distinguishes Free Match Stats & Highlights from Paid Personal Clips. Clear phone footage improves the result, processing can currently take up to 45 minutes, and event or player assignments should be reviewed before any clip is shared.

technologyStack.title: Computer Vision for Small-Sided Football
technologyStack.desc: Pitchside is being developed around phone-recorded small-sided football footage, where camera angles, lighting and player spacing are different from professional broadcast footage.
The beta system is being tested to identify goals, assists, saves, passes and tackles from match footage, with accuracy expected to improve as more footage is reviewed.
technologyStack.title: Event Detection in Testing
Phone-First Recording
technologyStack.desc: Pitchside aims to offer a phone-first workflow for teams that do not want to invest in dedicated football-camera hardware.
Uploads and processing are being tested during private beta. Current processing can take up to 45 minutes and the flow is expected to improve.

data.intro: The goal lasted a few seconds. The recording lasted an hour. Pitchside's AI football highlights experience is designed to find supported moments in phone-recorded 5-a-side, 6-a-side and 7-a-side matches, then organise them so players can review the action without scrubbing through the full video.
data.llmDescription: Pitchside's AI football highlights experience is designed to find supported moments in phone-recorded 5-a-side, 6-a-side and 7-a-side matches. Free Match Stats & Highlights cover the game within the monthly recording allowance. Paid Personal Clips organise supported moments around an individual player. Processing is not instant, output requires review and sharing still requires permission.
